notes: Production shown as gold sold (headline FY26 KPI: 1.54 Moz sold; gold recovered was 1,551,883 oz). All costs in the report are in AUD; AISC converted to USD at the report's FY26 average rate AUD:USD = 0.68 (Pogo disclosed as US$1,534/oz at 0.68). Group AISC US$1,835/oz. Company reports by Production Centre (Kalgoorlie, Yandal, Pogo); per-operation figures from Mine Operations Review (Table 1). Ore reserves reported at A$2,900/oz (Australia) and US$1,900/oz (Pogo), effective 31 Mar 2026. Group reserves 28.4 Moz; resources 88.9 Moz. 50% Central Tanami JV interest sold to MGX Resources Feb 2026. MD & CEO Stuart Tonkin. No material silver production disclosed.

mines.processing: Fimiston Processing Plant (13 Mtpa, expanding to 27 Mtpa via KCGM Mill Expansion; Stage I commissioned Sep 2026 quarter); Fimiston open pit + Mt Charlotte underground
mines.mine_notes: Kalgoorlie Production Centre. Gold recovered 480,429 oz. FY26 AISC A$2,495/oz converted at 0.68. Record open pit movement 88 Mtpa; underground 3.2 Mtpa. Mineral Resources 42.2 Moz (up 3.3 Moz).

mines.processing: Carosue Dam mill; underground mining plus stockpile processing (open pit at Wallbrook concluded as planned)
mines.mine_notes: Kalgoorlie Production Centre. Gold recovered 212,384 oz. FY26 AISC A$2,732/oz converted at 0.68. 3.8 Mt processed; lower grades from underground. Mineral Resources 3.9 Moz.

mines.processing: Underground mines at Kanowna Belle and South Kalgoorlie; Kanowna Belle processing plant
mines.mine_notes: Kalgoorlie Production Centre (South Kalgoorlie + Kanowna Belle). Gold recovered 155,200 oz. FY26 AISC A$2,617/oz converted at 0.68. Oct 2025 pit wall slip at South Kalgoorlie impacted production. Reserves combine SKO (10.3 Mt @ 3.0 g/t, 1,013 koz) and Kanowna (26.9 Mt @ 1.4 g/t, 1,245 koz).

Yandal Production Centre. Gold recovered 202,355 oz. FY26 AISC A$3,212/oz converted at 0.68. Production hit by Oct 2025 crusher circuit structural failure and lower underground grades. Mineral Resources 6.4 Moz; Ore Reserves 1.0 Moz.

mines.processing: Open pit mining (Thunderbox, Orelia, Bannockburn); Thunderbox mill (6.2 Mt processed FY26); Bronzewing exploration district
mines.mine_notes: Yandal Production Centre. Gold recovered 233,755 oz. FY26 AISC A$3,187/oz converted at 0.68. Record June-quarter sales of 67 koz. Mineral Resources 10.7 Moz; Ore Reserves 2.6 Moz.

Pogo Production Centre (Alaska). Gold recovered 267,761 oz. FY26 AISC disclosed US$1,534/oz (A$2,259/oz at 0.68). Fifth consecutive annual record net mine cash flow (A$609M). Lower grades from underground dilution.

Development project (Pilbara, WA), acquired via De Grey merger. First-time reserves: 140.1 Mt @ 1.2 g/t = 5.5 Moz; Mineral Resources 13.2 Moz. Final Investment Decision targeted late FY27. No FY26 production.
